# t_funcs.ramp_on { #clerq.t_funcs.ramp_on }

```python
t_funcs.ramp_on(index)
```

Return a ramp-on time function.

The pulse rises smoothly from zero using a half-Gaussian, then holds at
``ampl`` after the turn-on time ``on``.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                        | Default    |
|--------|--------|----------------------------------------------------|------------|
| index  | int    | Integer suffix used to look up parameters in args. | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                         |
|--------|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | TFunc  | Callable ``f(t, args)`` reading ``ampl_{index}``, ``fwhm_{index}``, |
|        | TFunc  | and ``on_{index}`` from args.                                       |
